purpose: Implement the single P0684 post-result formula generator as a registered three-dimensional QUMOND source operator on the spent RX J2129 baryonic map, and audit the field before any new raw-image root or topology score is computed.

selection_rule: Advance this exact field to the already frozen P0686 spent raw-topology audit only if every numerical, boundary, finite-field, exponent-range, intended-amplitude, curl, parameter-accounting, and no-score gate passes. No formula constant may change after this freeze.
claim_boundary: P0685 is a test of a post-result mechanism generator on a fully spent cluster, not independent validation.
The potential-depth and path-ratio coordinates are baryonic and parameter-free per object, but they are not yet derived from a covariant action.
The zero-slip photon rule is a weak-field diagnostic closure, not a relativistic lensing theory.
A strong, curl-free field can still fail image positions, multiplicity, parity, or critical curves.
No P0685 raw-image outcome and no sealed P0633 or P0640 target may be opened in this stage.
